page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-8 is an x86_64 server instance provisioned with 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores and 63.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9B45 processor with simultaneous multithreading, it features 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 (F, VNNI, BF16), AES, VAES, and SHA-NI cryptographic accelerators. The machine type carries an elevated memory-to-vCPU ratio of roughly 7.88 GB per vCPU, placing it into a high-memory tier, while bundling no local storage or discrete graphics processing units.

Benchmark data reveals exceptional single-core processing capabilities. The instance registers top-tier results in single-threaded operations, including a stress-ng single-core score of 3451.09, a Geekbench single-core score of 2589.0, single-threaded gzip compression at 37.91 GB/sec, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression at 16.87 GB/sec. Geekbench text processing and small-model LLM text generation (373.98 tokens/sec) also achieve top-decile standings. In contrast, aggregate parallel metrics—including multi-core stress-ng (13798.02), multi-core Geekbench (10050.0), and PassMark CPU (17638.96)—align within median tiers due to the 8 vCPU ceiling.

Memory subsystem measurements indicate a read bandwidth of 840.48 GB/sec for small cached blocks, transitioning to 49.49 GB/sec read and 33.55 GB/sec write for large uncached 256 MB blocks. Key in-memory throughput tests show 15.1 million Redis SET operations per second and a PassMark database score of 5501.74. However, processing larger models without hardware acceleration poses bottlenecks, evident in prompt evaluation throughput dropping to 30.47 tokens/sec on 7B parameter models.

The c4d-highmem-8 offers high memory capacity alongside superior single-thread speed, delivering balanced operational value for workloads that do not demand extensive core scaling. Because persistent local disks are absent, it relies entirely on networked block storage. This profile matches in-memory caches, relational database systems, memory-bound data pipelines, and text-processing services.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-8 is a high-memory server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B45 processor with 8 vCPUs, 4 physical cores, and 63.0 GB of RAM, offering approximately 7.88 GB per vCPU. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the processor features 32 MB of L3 cache and supports AVX-512 and cryptographic instruction extensions. It contains no bundled local storage or GPUs. Synthetic benchmarks show top-tier single-core CPU throughput, leading results in single-threaded compression and Geekbench single-core evaluation, alongside median-tier multi-threaded and memory bandwidth performance. Delivering 15.1 million Redis SET operations per second, it provides resource density oriented toward memory capacity over parallel core volume. The server is well suited for in-memory databases, Redis deployments, data processing pipelines, and enterprise applications requiring substantial RAM alongside fast single-threaded performance.
